summary: Stocks closed a volatile session lower: the Nifty gave up early gains and fell about 0.4%, while the Sensex ended nearly flat as private banks cushioned it.

detail.tone: The close was slightly better than the closing-auction print, but the Nifty still ended a third straight session lower to end September on a weak note.
watch: Oct 1 auto sales and FII provisional flows

top.title: Apollo, Max end as top Nifty losers
top.line: Hospital stocks closed at the bottom of the Nifty after the SC flagged medicine mark-ups
more: Apollo Hospitals, Max Healthcare and BSE were the top Nifty50 losers
Healthcare and pharma were the weakest sectors at the close

top.title: RBI MPC meets Oct 5–7; rate call on Oct 7
top.line: The rate decision is the next big domestic trigger after a bruising September
more: The MPC meets from October 5 to 7, with the repo decision due on October 7
The RBI's revised deposit-rate framework takes effect from October 1

top.title: FIIs sold ₹33,864 cr in September to date
top.line: DIIs have bought ₹64,759 cr this month, absorbing heavy foreign selling
more: The month-to-date figures run through September 29
Provisional data for today is due from NSE around 5 pm

top.title: September auto sales due Oct 1
top.line: Monthly volumes will test demand as Maruti, Tata Motors and Hyundai raise prices
